_note: First-time hints (garage/hints.js): each shown once, the first time what it's about happens (when), where the player is (drive: on the road; garage), and never again (the player's save keeps the ones seen). when — damage: the car's damaged; mechanical: something bent, leaking or worn by a crash; loose: a part hanging loose or torn off; undrivable: it can't carry on racing; replay: a crash replay is playing; damageTab: the garage with a damaged car; safetyNet: the free basic repair is offered.

hints.title: Your car is damaged
hints.text: Visit the garage to repair it: its Damage tab lists every problem.

hints.title: Something's bent or leaking
hints.text: The dashboard lamps show what's wrong, and I opens the damage report. The garage puts it right.

hints.title: A part's hanging off
hints.text: It drags, and can fall off. The garage bolts it back on — a part torn off comes back with the car.

hints.title: The car can't carry on
hints.text: Tow it to the garage (Backspace, twice) for repairs.

hints.title: Crash replay
hints.text: Any key skips it. Switch replays off in the settings (O).

hints.title: Damage report
hints.text: Every problem and what it does. Click one to see it on the car. A quick repair is cheaper and leaves it at about 80%; a full one makes it as new.

hints.title: Short of money?
hints.text: The workshop will patch your car up just enough to drive, for free: Damage tab.
